[About the Explanations and Glossary]
The content presented in the artwork explanations and glossary is based on one interpretation among several existing theories. 
Therefore, in cases where the information is not necessarily incorrect, we may choose not to revise it. 
We hope for your kind understanding in this matter.

notes.title: Scheduled for Early Summer 2025!
notes.content:
The release window has been decided!
Both the Steam and Nintendo Switch versions will be available in early summer 2025. Please stay tuned until the release!

Steam Version : "Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum"
Nintendo Switch Version : "Picross™: Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum"

Our official website is now open.

This time, we’re introducing one of the "Memory Pixel Puzzles" you can play in "Curator's Private Room".
You all recognize this illustration, right?
Of course, Curator Raden will also share their nostalgic episode related to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333464/1f6bb7e4c1010d8a8a67170ae56286fbf81a0ba4.png
What other memories and expressions of the Curator Raden await? Stay tuned to find out!


■Game Summary
Title : Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum
Genre : Picture Crossword Puzzle
Players : Singleplayer
Price : ¥2,420 (tax included)
Release Date : Early Summer 2025 (Scheduled)
Language : Japanese, English


We will keep you updated on our store page and on X.
